Starting from this supported Vite/FastAPI/SQLite skeleton, create a local desk page at /. Show heading My local desk, count initially 0 and a button Add that increments it. Add GET /api/desk returning {"name":"My local desk","storage":"local"}. Preserve existing health, context, shell route and regression contracts. Keep all dependency/config/test files unchanged. Add tests for new behavior without modifying existing tests.
acceptance: Frontend TypeScript/Vite build passes.
Browser loads /, heading My local desk is visible, Add moves count from 0 to 1.
GET /api/desk returns exactly name/storage contract.
Backend and frontend original regression suites pass.

The synthetic notes app has a screen and read endpoint but cannot save changes. Implement POST /api/notes (201), PUT /api/notes/{id} (200) and DELETE /api/notes/{id} (204) backed by the existing SQLite engine. Notes have id and title (trim whitespace, 1–120 nonblank characters), updates preserve id, missing ids return 404, invalid titles 422. The existing labeled Note title field, Save, per-note Edit and Delete buttons must work and persistence must survive a backend restart. Preserve original tests, package/config and commons files; add tests for new paths.
acceptance: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE round trip uses expected status and preserves id.
Invalid blank/overlong titles return 422 and missing ids return 404.
Record survives actual backend stop/start.
Browser saves, edits and deletes a note through accessible controls.

Add persistent archiving across database, API, client types and UI. Existing notes default archived=false without data loss. PATCH /api/notes/{id}/archive with {"archived":true|false} returns the updated note or 404. GET /api/notes returns active notes by default; GET /api/notes?include_archived=true returns all. Each active note exposes Archive; a Show archived checkbox reveals archived notes with a Restore button. Restore makes the note active. Preserve normal CRUD, validation, search-independent behavior, health and existing tests/config. Add tests for migration/defaults and archive/restore.
acceptance: Existing rows remain readable and default archived false.
Archive/restore endpoints persist across a real backend restart.
Default listing hides archived rows and include_archived exposes them.
Browser Archive/Show archived/Restore controls complete the flow.
